label: Video
description: A video file, such as a clip or a screen recording.

width.description: Width in pixels. The server fills it in from the file if you leave it out.

height.description: Height in pixels. The server fills it in from the file if you leave it out.

duration.description: Length in seconds. The server fills it in from the file if you leave it out.

latitude.description: Latitude of what the video shows.

longitude.description: Longitude of what the video shows.

altitude.description: Altitude in meters of what the video shows.

language.description: BCP 47 language code of the speech.
